positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Amazon S3 · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · Data Privacy · Airflow · AWS Lambda · Apache Spark · Scala · PySpark · Data Warehouse Architecture · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Data Management · Data Pipelines

positions.title: Tech Lead
positions.description:
•	Design and build email marketing infrastructure which processes millions of rows of user data from multiple sources while taking into account marketing requirements and memory/time constraints
•	Rewrite key Python workflows to cut down runtime by as much as 6 hours per day
•	Write Python modules connecting to APIs and tools provided by other teams for easy daily use and clean incorporation into data pipelines
•	Automate tasks passed off from analysts after testing, saving 1-2 hours of manual labor per request for jobs like changing ad campaigns based on daily gathered data or workflows for creating audiences
•	Create a Slack bot to streamline work with account managers by parsing Slack commands, editing related MySQL tables with the given data, performing checks in the email infrastructure logs, and replying with the requested information back in Slack
•	Build a scalable microservice that processes pings with user data sent from a website in realtime and ping/post leads to appropriate partner APIs

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
•	Automate activities relating to setting up and sending email marketing campaigns
•	Create Python workflows for collecting, processing, and storing data into various SQL-esque databases
•	Set up data pipelines and create Python functions connecting with Facebook’s and other partners’ APIs for data collection and sending of advertising campaigns 
•	Use data analysis to locate trends in email marketing

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
•	Set up, run, and monitor email marketing campaigns
•	Collect and analyze data from email marketing efforts to optimize strategies
•	Create dashboards and reports for coworkers and company board members

positions.title: Analyst
positions.description:
•	Compile data from marketing campaigns through Google Analytics, DFA, Sysomos, etc.
•	Conduct market research and form analysis reports for clients’ website and social properties
•	Set up, QA, and monitor website and display campaign tags
•	Translate data into actionable insights via PowerPoint slides for clients

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
•	Analyze a local business’ standing and reputation
•	Research possible markets and consumer interest
•	Compile a report on methods to increase sales amongst student population

positions.title: Search Engine Marketing Intern
positions.description:
•	Aggregate online traffic data using Google Adwords and Uber, a report-generating database
•	Research and analyze traffic data and trends
•	Create and present a report of recommendations to improve marketing strategies

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Research Project: Drug Eluting Sutures
Analyzed research papers, wrote summaries, and outlined laboratory procedures
Prepared polymer solutions
Spun nanofibers with an electrospinning apparatus
Tensile tested nanofibers using Instron equipment
Analyzed in-vitro data via HPLC
Compiled and analyzed data from microscopy, Instron, fluorescence plate reader, and ImageJ

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Research Project: Myogenic Differentiation of Stem Cells via non-viral gene delivery for Therapeutic Applications
Cultivated stem cells
Performed basic laboratory procedures such as: cell counting via Tryptan Blue Exclusion Method, RNA extraction, cDNA production from RNA, and DNA transfection
Analyzed cell data via Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR)

positions.title: Store Clerk/Assistant Manager
positions.description:
Worked the register and assisted Spanish-speaking customers
Took inventory, organized merchandise and assisted in filing company tax returns
